sentences.text: The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a government welfare scheme aimed at providing financial support to farmers in India.
The scheme was launched in February 2019.
Its primary objective is to provide income support to small and marginal farmers.
Under this scheme eligible farmers receive direct cash transfers of Rs. 6000 per year.
This amount is disbursed in three equal installments of Rs. 2000 each.
Eligibility for the scheme includes small and marginal farmers who own cultivable land.
Farmers must have landholding up to 2 hectares to qualify for the scheme.
The application process involves self-registration through the official PM-KISAN portal.
Farmers can also apply through state government offices or local agricultural departments.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare.
Payments are made directly to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.
The scheme is expected to be implemented on an ongoing basis.
Farmers can check their status and updates through the PM-KISAN portal.
